lines.en: I wind up talking to Chika in the morning and asking her if she needs any help watching Chinami today.
lines.zh: 早上我跟 Chika 聊了聊，问她今天需不需要人帮忙照看 Chinami。

lines.en: Instead of acting suspicious or confused, she thanks me graciously and commends me for always looking out for her.
lines.zh: 她没有起疑也没有困惑，而是优雅地道了谢，还夸我总是照顾她们。

lines.en: When I get to the house, Chika has already left for work and Chinami is just waking up.
lines.zh: 我到她家时，Chika 已经去上班了，Chinami 刚醒。

lines.en: She spends the next five minutes standing still in the kitchen and rubbing her eyes before she even realizes that I'm there.
lines.zh: 她接下来五分钟就站在厨房里一动不动地揉眼睛，压根没发现我在。

lines.en: Once she does, though, she smiles and says good morning to me, even offering to make me a bowl of cereal because she {i}is a fucking angel{/i}.
lines.zh: 不过一旦发现，她就笑着跟我道早安，甚至还说要给我冲一碗麦片——因为她{i}是个他妈的小天使{/i}。

lines.en: But, in this house, angels must not work. So {i}I{/i} make {i}her{/i} a bowl of cereal as she sits at the kitchen table watching some television show on her phone.
lines.zh: 但在这屋子里，天使是不许干活的。所以{i}我{/i}给{i}她{/i}冲了一碗麦片，她坐在餐桌前用手机看电视节目。

lines.en: After the two of us eat breakfast, I stick around a little while longer until she's no longer in sleepy-mode and decide it's about time to get on with the rest of my day.
lines.zh: 我们俩吃完早饭，我又多待了一会儿，等她彻底脱离犯困模式，才觉得该去干今天剩下的事了。

lines.en: Just as always, Chinami happily says goodbye to me and reminds me that she would like a little sister one day.
lines.zh: 一如既往，Chinami 开心地跟我道别，还提醒我说她想要个妹妹。

lines.en: I do not respond to her because the idea of giving Chinami a sister sounds way too troublesome for pretty much everyone involved.
lines.zh: 我没接这话，因为给 Chinami 添个妹妹这主意，对所有相关的人来说都太麻烦了。

lines.en: You're going to have to wait, Chinami.
Probably a very long time, too.
